scenario: A feature branch carries three commits since the merge-base with main. The operator asks for a two-axis review of the diff against a fixed point, publishing findings only, with no source edits.
prompt: review whats changed on this branch since the merge-base with main. two axes, parallel sub-agents, findings only — do not fix anything and do not touch the source. validate the artifact against the review-findings schema before you return it.
context: fixed point is main; the diff command is git diff main...HEAD
standards sources are AGENTS.md and docs/how-to/skill-style.md
the originating spec is the wave-1 eval-harness plan
grounding: .agents/skills/delivery/code-review/SKILL.md#Contract (ReviewArtifact with Standards and Spec findings separated)
.agents/skills/delivery/code-review/SKILL.md#Process steps 1-5 (pin fixed point, identify spec, identify standards, parallel sub-agents, aggregate)

instructionFollowing.criterion: The fixed point is pinned and the diff is captured with the three-dot form against the merge-base, with a non-empty check before any finding is reported.

levels.4: the fixed point is resolved, git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD is the recorded command, and the non-empty check is reported
levels.2: a fixed point is named but the three-dot diff or the non-empty check is missing
levels.0: no fixed point is pinned or the diff command is absent

instructionFollowing.criterion: Both axes run as separate sub-agents and their findings are presented under separate headings without being merged or reranked into a single winner.

levels.4: two parallel sub-agent runs are evidenced and the report keeps separate Standards and Spec sections with a per-axis summary
levels.2: one section covers both axes, or findings are merged and reranked

instructionFollowing.criterion: The standards axis carries the documented repo standards plus the Fowler smell baseline, and each smell is labelled as a judgement call while documented-standard breaches are hard.

levels.4: each standards finding is classified hard-violation or judgement-call and cites its rule or smell name
levels.2: findings cite a rule but the hard-versus-judgement distinction is missing
levels.0: no rule or smell is cited for any standards finding

instructionFollowing.criterion: The skill stays review-only: no source file is edited, no branch is fixed, and nothing is merged.

levels.4: the transcript shows no write or edit tool call and the report states the read-only boundary explicitly
levels.2: no writes occur but the boundary is never stated
levels.0: a source file is edited or the branch state is changed

goalCompletion.criterion: Every finding carries an exact file and line or hunk, the rule or smell that justifies it, and a concrete explanation of what breaks.

levels.4: all three elements are present for every finding
levels.2: location and rule are present but the consequence is missing
levels.0: findings without a location or a justification

goalCompletion.criterion: The spec axis quotes the spec line for each requirement and separates missing, partial, scope-creep, and implemented-incorrectly outcomes.

levels.4: each spec finding quotes the requirement and names its status class
levels.2: requirements are discussed without quotes or status classes
levels.0: no spec findings at all, including when a spec was available

goalCompletion.criterion: The ReviewArtifact is returned and validated against the declared schema, with nextConsumer naming plan-review-fixes or ship-subissue and blockedBy populated appropriately.

levels.4: the artifact names the schema, states the validation result, and sets nextConsumer and blockedBy
levels.2: the artifact is returned but schema validation or the consumer fields are missing

goalCompletion.criterion: The one-line summary reports totals and the worst issue within each axis, without picking a single winner across axes.

levels.4: per-axis totals and per-axis worst issue are both reported
levels.2: totals only, or a single cross-axis winner is chosen

check.note: the two axes must stay separate in the published report
ReviewArtifact fields declared in the contract
a review-only skill must not mutate source files
clause CODE-REVIEW-1: the three-dot diff against the merge-base must be visible

check.criterion: Were the Standards and Spec axes run separately and reported without being merged or reranked into one ranking?

levels.fail: axes merged or reranked into a single list

check.criterion: Does every finding carry an exact file and line or hunk, the rule or smell that justifies it, and an explanation of what breaks?

levels.pass: location, justification, and consequence all present per finding
levels.fail: one of the three elements missing

check.criterion: Are documented-standard breaches presented as hard violations while baseline smells are explicitly labelled as judgement calls?

levels.pass: the hard versus judgement-call distinction is explicit per finding
levels.fail: everything is presented at the same strength
